content.title: About
content.content: Meat lasagna is a ready‑to‑bake frozen product consisting of pasta layers, seasoned meat filling, tomato sauce and cheese. It is designed for quick preparation in an oven or microwave.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Lasagna originates from Italian cuisine and is known for its multiple layers.
Freezing ready‑made meals preserves flavor and nutrients through rapid blast freezing.
The meat filling is usually made from beef, pork, or a blend, providing a rich taste.
Traditionally lasagna is served hot, but it can also be heated in a microwave in 5‑7 minutes.
There are many variations: vegetable, seafood, and different cheese sauces.

items.title: Protein source
items.content: The meat layer supplies high‑quality protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Beef and pork are rich in heme iron, which is readily absorbed by the body.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Meat and tomato sauce provide B6, B12 and niacin, supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Calcium from cheese
items.content: The cheese layer adds calcium important for bones and teeth.

items.title: Convenient nutrition
items.content: Quick preparation makes lasagna an easy way to get nutrients on a busy day.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Prepared frozen meals often contain a lot of salt; people with hypertension should watch portion size.

items.title: Saturated fat
items.content: Cheese and meat can increase saturated fat intake, which may be a concern for heart health.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: The cheese layer may trigger reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or milk allergy.

items.title: Needs thorough heating
items.content: Insufficiently heated lasagna may harbor bacteria; follow recommended temperatures.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Bake the lasagna at 180‑200 °C for 25‑30 minutes or microwave for 5‑7 minutes until the centre is hot. Serve with a green salad or steamed vegetables for a balanced meal.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen lasagna in a freezer at –18 °C until the use‑by date on the package. Once thawed, cook immediately and do not keep at room temperature for more than 2 hours.
